{{Infobox auto}}

A '''pumpkin empanada''' is the meal of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Value|Pumpkin Empanada|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for {{Value|Pumpkin Empanada|duration|effect=Resistance}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pumpkin_empanada.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]], sugar, estus ash and [[dough]]. Obtaining a baked pumpkin unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a pumpkin empanada takes {{Value|Pumpkin Empanada|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Pumpkin Empanada|heals}} and gives Resistance {{Value|Pumpkin Empanada|level|effect=Resistance}} for {{Value|Pumpkin Empanada|duration|effect=Resistance|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_29.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|Upcoming|2=Villagers can pick it as their [[favorite food]] and buy it once for 1 obol.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* The developer describes it as pumpkin baked "with sugar and spice".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Preserve the pumpkin into pumpkin jam for more potent resistance, or bake it with sugar and spice to make a delicious empanada.}}</ref>
